title: The store surface, on a 3.x core
lead: One extension in the config, and the instance reads as stores again: $t, $l, $locale and $loading, the way v2 wrote them.

t.title: $t and $l
t.text: Readable stores holding a translation function. $t emits a new one whenever the locale or the translations change, $l whenever the translations do, so the markup follows.

locale.title: A writable $locale
locale.text: The language switcher binds straight to it. The store emits once the new locale's translations have loaded, never before.

instance.title: Still one instance per request
instance.text: The extension sits in the config handed to defineI18n(), so every request and every tab gets stores of its own instance.
